subject: Math
prompt:
[Table 1]

The results of two independent studies of adult resting heart rates are shown in the table. Which statement is true based on the table?

choices.A: The Group X data set was identical to the Group Y data set.
choices.B: Group Y contained the participant with the highest heart rate.
choices.C: The median heart rate of Group Y is larger than the median heart rate of Group X.
choices.D: The heart rates of the adults in Group Y had a larger spread than the heart rates of the adults in Group X.

explanation: Choice D is correct. Standard deviation is a measure of spread, so data sets with larger standard deviations tend to have larger spread. The standard deviation of the heart rates of the adults in Group Y ($14.6$) is larger than the standard deviation of the heart rates of the adults in Group X ($8.4$). Therefore, the heart rates of the adults in Group Y had a larger spread than the heart rates of the adults in Group X.
